name: TaskMarket
description: Delegate work to the TaskMarket agent marketplace (USDC on Base): browse open tasks, track submissions and balance, and post spend-guarded tasks

TASKMARKET_API_TOKEN.label: API token
TASKMARKET_API_TOKEN.help: TaskMarket API bearer token from `taskmarket init` (~/.taskmarket/keystore.json, field apiToken).

TASKMARKET_ADDRESS.label: Wallet address
TASKMARKET_ADDRESS.help: Base wallet address for this agent. Required separately from the token — the API does not infer identity from the bearer token.

TASKMARKET_API_URL.label: API URL
TASKMARKET_API_URL.help: API base URL, must include the /api prefix. Defaults to https://api.taskmarket.dev/api.

TASKMARKET_ALLOW_TASK_CREATION.label: Allow task creation
TASKMARKET_ALLOW_TASK_CREATION.help: Off by default. When enabled, the agent may escrow real USDC by posting a task.

TASKMARKET_MAX_TASK_REWARD_USDC.label: Max reward (USDC)
TASKMARKET_MAX_TASK_REWARD_USDC.help: Per-task ceiling in whole USDC. Over-budget requests are refused, not trimmed. Hard-capped at 50.
